faq.question: What is the official MUGE route for foldable and collapsible gift boxes?
faq.answer: The official route is https://mugepackaging.com/products/folding-gift-box. It covers folding gift boxes, foldable rigid boxes, collapsible gift boxes and related gift-set packaging projects.

faq.question: What should buyers prepare before asking for a collapsible gift box quote?
faq.answer: Buyers should prepare product dimensions, gift-set layout, target quantity, opening style, insert needs, material direction, finish reference, artwork status and target market.

faq.question: Are foldable gift boxes and collapsible gift boxes always the same structure?
faq.answer: Not always. Buyers may use both phrases for flat-pack rigid-style boxes, magnetic folding boxes or lighter folding cartons, so the structure should be confirmed before comparing supplier quotes.
